chunks: "A sacrificial animal is not to be offered except from what is purchased during the ten days."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْعَشْرِ: the ten days, referring to the first ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah
key_terms.يُضَحَّى: to offer as a sacrificial animal

ai.seo_question: When should an udhiyah sacrificial animal be purchased according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the udhiyah sacrificial offering. It indicates that the sacrificial animal should be one that is purchased during the first ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah, emphasizing proper timing in the preparation of the ritual.
